DAM-48: refine camellia shadcn style shell (#50)

## Summary
- add an explicit Camellia style registry so the current `shadcn-ui` preset is named and extensible instead of hard-coded through string literals
- refresh shared scaffold primitives in `packages/ui` so page headers, section cards, query toolbars, and form sections render with a more deliberate shadcn-style shell
- tighten the Camellia login and console shell chrome to expose the active style and align the overall presentation with the requested UI direction

## Why
- DAM-48 clarified that the work needs an actual visual style pass, not only a structural cleanup
- the issue also requires room for future style presets, so the theme wiring now treats styles as a registry rather than a single special case
- this PR intentionally targets `dam-47-camellia-ui-refactor-plan` so the style pass layers directly onto the broader UI refactor branch

## Validation
- `pnpm --dir bougainvillea run check:camellia`
- `pnpm --dir bougainvillea --filter @bougainvillea/camellia start`
- `curl -I http://127.0.0.1:3000/login`
- `curl -I http://127.0.0.1:3000/`
- `curl -I http://127.0.0.1:3000/playground`
- `curl -I http://127.0.0.1:3000/ai/template`
- `curl -s http://127.0.0.1:3000/login | rg -n "shadcn/ui|Current style|Authentication|Default app|Access hints"`
- `git diff --check`

## UI Walkthrough
- Open `/login` and verify the refreshed two-column shell shows the active `shadcn/ui` style badge, style summary card, access hints, and the tighter authentication card presentation.
- Open `/` with a valid saved session and verify the console header and sidebar both surface the active style and role information with the updated card-backed chrome.
- Open representative routes such as `/playground` and `/ai/template` and confirm the shared page header, section card, form, and query toolbar surfaces inherit the updated scaffold styling.

## Notes
- Browser screenshot automation was attempted, but Playwright Chromium could not start in this environment because `libglib-2.0.so.0` is unavailable. Validation fell back to deterministic route and HTML checks.
